summary_md: **开源雷达 | AI 工具日报 ([@DropRadar_io](https://x.com/DropRadar_io/status/2116751037243740339))** recommends **agentring**, which lets a stuck agent phone you over self-hosted VoIP; a voice AI explains the blocker, you decide verbally and the transcript goes back to the agent (Android pre-release only) ([mutonby/agentring](https://github.com/mutonby/agentring)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - mutonby/agentring: Let your AI agents call your phone over VoIP, and call them back. Your phone rings like a real call, even locked; a voice AI talks it through and returns the transcript. Self-hosted, open source, no phone numbers or Twilio.
